pr953.title: [Model] Extend DFlash2 QPN8 candidate heads to concurrent verification
pr953.runtime_fact: Production startup graph_options record qpn8_rerank=true. Existing original-head FP16 weights feed online QPN8 support search and original FP16/FP32 candidate rescoring. FP16 LM-head dtype alone is insufficient to decline this PR.
pr953.batch_guard: Existing candidate rerank admits at most8 rows. Larger concurrent verification falls back to the existing dense head. MAX_ROWS guard and runtime head details must remain distinct from NVFP4 intermediate-projection admission.
pr953.corrected_status: Optional head concurrency extension is unmeasured in this round. It is not denied by the old unrelated native-admission result. This round selected a source-correlated q8 shared-bank mechanism as its additional deep experiment, and withdrew that experiment after measured slowdown.
pr953.future_gate: Preserve exact original-head scoring, target full-vocabulary fallback and sampling support. Re-evaluate actual concurrent head critical-path cost and candidate coverage before enabling a new batched route.
